tokens.name: comic-red
tokens.usage: Brand red. Bursts, offset accent shadows, highlight blocks, marker underlines, display type 24px+ only (3.86:1 on warm-paper). Never small text, never a button fill — use press-red.

tokens.name: comic-yellow
tokens.usage: Brand yellow. Highlighter marks, callout fills, selected labels — always with ink-black text on top (11.88:1). Never text, never white text on it; on warm-paper it needs an ink-black outline (1.40:1 alone).

tokens.name: comic-blue
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Technical elements, annotations, secondary actions, focus ring on paper. Text on warm-paper, paper-bright, paper-shade, panel-gray (6.8–8.3:1). Never on ink-black (2.12:1).

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Ink. Text, every outline, offset shadows, dark surfaces. 16.59:1 on warm-paper.

tokens.name: warm-paper
tokens.usage: Paper. The dominant page ground, and text on ink-black.

tokens.name: panel-gray
tokens.usage: Neutral surface for supporting UI: archived status, disabled controls, metadata strips.

tokens.name: press-red
tokens.usage: Refined red for small sizes: primary button fill (warm-paper label 5.30:1) and red text on paper grounds (4.62–5.62:1). Added because comic-red fails 4.5:1 for small text.

tokens.name: press-red-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed state of press-red (warm-paper label 6.75:1).

tokens.name: blue-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed state of comic-blue (warm-paper label 10.22:1).

tokens.name: blue-light
tokens.usage: Comic-blue for the ink theme: technical text and secondary action on ink grounds (7.6–8.9:1); ink-black text on it 8.42:1.

tokens.name: red-light
tokens.usage: Red text on ink grounds (6.4–7.6:1); pressed primary in the ink theme.
